'''Hangar 61''' or '''Docking Bay 61''' was one of the hangars located in [[Sobrik Spaceport]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Prior to the [[Galactic War]], it was operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the disguised [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mashallon]] attempted to escape from Balmorra via that hangar.<ref name="TOR" />
